title: HelperSSHConnectionsParams
description: Params of the ssh service's connections op (nocx-oalo1.6.2). It carries NOTHING, and that is the declaration rather than a placeholder: the question is 'what does this helper hold for the coordinator asking', and the coordinator is a property of the connection the request arrived on (D12), not of a field. additionalProperties:false with no properties is what makes the emptiness exact — a payload carrying a field is a caller that believes it is asking a narrower question, and accepting it silently would answer a different one.
